scripts.test:unit: uv run pytest -m "not integration" && pnpm --filter @mask/web test
scripts.test:unit:ci: uv run pytest -m "not integration" --junitxml=reports/python-unit.xml && pnpm --filter @mask/web test:ci
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run check:services && uv run pytest --integration tests/integration --junitxml=reports/python-integration.xml
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter @mask/web lint && pnpm --filter @mask/web format:check && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:progress
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy apps/api/src workers && pnpm --filter @mask/web typecheck
scripts.migrate: uv run alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.schemas:check: uv run python scripts/export-openapi.py --check && pnpm --filter @mask/schemas check
